notes: New: the Ganio Assistant. The Ganio logo now floats beside Logic: tap it for a panel with your song's next step, every mix pass and chain, Watch it happen / Your turn sends, and “How does it sound?” buttons. Open a Channel EQ and the panel offers help for that track. Pin it to the side of the screen and Logic makes room. Also: Ganio Link has its real app icon, and Dial it in closes cleanly on “Sounds good”.
